requiredFindings.location: PLAN-r3.md section 1.0, downward automatic population and anchor-entry exception
requiredFindings.title: Separate pruned-anchor observations from nested-boundary evidence
requiredFindings.finding: The adapter excludes everything strictly below each excluding anchor, but then retains every anchor directory with its .git or opensip.json child. Those children are strictly below the anchor. A walker cannot obtain .opensip/.git or .opensip/opensip.json from the selected root parent listing without opening/listing the pruned directory. The same problem applies to node_modules, VCS and Cargo-output anchors. The population property only checks output paths against the retained population and cannot detect an unlawfully retained input child.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Give pruning precedence over boundary detection. A pruned anchor contributes only its own parent-observed entry and no children. Keep the .git/opensip.json evidence exception only for ordinary directories whose boundary must be detected, never for an already pruned directory. Add direct adapter-population assertions that even those specially named children are absent under every pruned reason, alongside native no-open/list/stat-inside controls.

requiredFindings.location: PLAN-r3.md section 1.0, explicit/config chain population and two-pass assertion; LD-B2B-8
requiredFindings.title: Preserve ancestor Cargo-root evidence before checking exact roots
requiredFindings.finding: The explicit/config adapter retains chain directories and their .git/opensip.json children, but omits Cargo.toml on those ancestors. Cargo roots are then derived only from markers in the retained population. This can turn a refused join inside Cargo target into an accepted unit. Comparing only selectedRoot and unit source between passes does not detect it.

reproduction.invocation: explicitProject=/h/w, explicitJoins=[target/u], cwd=/h/w, accountHome=/h, invokingUid=1000; ordinary custody-passing synthetic metadata
reproduction.specifiedChainRestriction: After omitting /h/w/Cargo.toml, ACCEPT with unit /h/w/target/u; selectedRoot and unitSource unchanged.

requiredFindings.requiredChange: Include the necessary ancestor marker observations to establish Cargo pruning before walking or admitting any named root. Do not descend into a known excluded target while building the population. Specify how the adapter preserves applicable finish-time JOIN refusals and add explicit/config target-join controls plus an ordinary-target-without-Cargo control. Keep unrelated subtrees excluded; do not solve this with a whole-root scan.
